unlisted_practices: Two-stage LLM pipeline (candidate identification followed by context-grounded verification) to detect internal documentation inconsistencies in EHR discharge summaries
Graded ontology and schema for characterizing EHR inconsistencies by category, section, domain, and inconsistency axis

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM pipeline retrospectively on MIMIC-IV clinical notes to detect internal documentation inconsistencies, characterizing failure modes and reliability via expert review, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
